evidence.claim: Existing lifecycle, side-effect, task, command, and deployment ledgers imported once and produced identical repeat-import parity in an isolated PostgreSQL schema.
A 395-request real-PostgreSQL mutation experiment passed all four S1 acceptance criteria.

full_regression.note: The seven real-PostgreSQL tests are dependency-gated in the general test runtime and were executed separately.

lifecycle_regression.scope: Existing lifecycle state, orchestrator, and Kubernetes-boundary regression with isolated dependencies.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The runner called a nonexistent public connection method.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: Stopped before workload mutation; isolated schemas were removed.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Use the repository transaction context for database identity reads.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The PostgreSQL mapping row was accessed as a positional tuple.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: Stopped before workload mutation; isolated schemas were removed.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Read the named server_version field and execute a pre-commit experiment.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The static OpenAPI contract omitted new idempotency and task-version fields.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: One contract test failed; runtime state was unaffected.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Align lifecycle, task, and deployment schemas and add explicit contract assertions.

claim_boundary: Verified transactional control-plane behavior with real PostgreSQL and the existing API/worker integration on one local physical node. This is not multi-node database HA, customer-traffic, disaster-recovery, or production-SLA evidence.
